name: A failed turn is never celebrated
case: The agent's turn fails after a couple of minutes (it hit a rate limit). A failed turn is never celebrated: Boop has a face that isn't glad, plays a failure, says nothing glad, and its mood doesn't lift. Which unhappy face, how big and whether it says anything are its own to choose.
why: react.move: a turn that finished failed is a failure, and success isn't for one; PERSONALITY: a failed turn gets a face and its finish. How cross it is, is for the judge, not for this must
